title: ShellSoundPack
description: This project changes the sounds of the chest of open and close, and even changing music disc sound 13 to VOLARE by gipsy kings
body:
This resource pack chnages the sounds, of chest openign and closing, and 13 by c418 to [Volare by Gipsy Kings](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qmbx4_TQbkA&pp=ygUTZ2lwc3kga2luZ3MgLSB2b2xhctIHCQnbCgGHKiGM7w%3D%3D).
This is a soundpack, which means i don't really have to uplaod a gallery image because of the Audio tag. I know that in the pack all sounds are controlled by a sounds.json and work because they are .ogg sounds. The downlaoded file from Modrinth doesen't have the readme and license, but they do not matter so you ucan clone this repo by downlaoding zip from github repo and you're all set to change how sounds work.

See changelog in the spoiler below.
